aboutPage.title: About the Directorate
aboutPage.subtitle: Efficient industrial zone governance, commissioning new facilities, and comprehensive investor support in Navoiy Region.
aboutPage.lead: The Directorate is a state institution established under the Navoiy Region Hokimiyat for prompt operational governance of industrial zones and full assistance to enterprises.
aboutPage.lawNotice: Our operations are conducted in accordance with the 'Regulation on Small Industrial Zones' approved by the Cabinet of Ministers Resolution No. 134 dated March 9, 2020, as well as the charter approved by the Hokimiyat.
aboutPage.zoneDef: A small industrial zone is a designated territory with clearly defined boundaries and utility infrastructure intended for manufacturing operations. Such zones are established on the basis of inactive industrial premises and non-agricultural vacant land plots.
aboutPage.leaseRole: The Directorate acts as the lessor of production premises and land plots within the zone territory and serves as the primary contractor for master plans.
aboutPage.goal1Desc: Transparent and open assignment of industrial land plots to entrepreneurs through electronic online auctions.
aboutPage.goal2Desc: End-to-end practical support for project initiators from design to full commercial operations.
aboutPage.goal3Desc: Providing industrial zones with uninterrupted electricity, gas, water, sewage, and high-quality access roads.
goals: Establishing manufacturing aligned with designated sectoral specialization
Creating new permanent employment opportunities for the local workforce
Attracting direct investments and advanced manufacturing technologies
Launching export-oriented and import-substituting production capacities
Reintegrating vacant plots and unused facilities into the economic cycle
tasks: Formulating investment projects and engaging potential industrial partners
Comprehensive organizational and administrative management of industrial zones
Executing project implementation agreements and long-term lease contracts
Allocating approved projects and maintaining the unified participant register
Systematic monitoring of the fulfillment of investor commitments
Practical facilitation of engineering utility and grid connections
Prompt resolution of production, legal, and operational matters

tasksPage.title: Tasks & Functions
tasksPage.subtitle: Core priorities and mandate assigned to the Directorate under government regulations.
tasksPage.task1: Organizing master plan development for industrial zones and submitting them for approval;
tasksPage.task2: Coordinating engineering utilities and access road infrastructure maintenance;
tasksPage.task3: Managing the leasing of land plots through transparent electronic online auctions;
tasksPage.task4: Continuous monitoring and hands-on facilitation in investment project execution;
tasksPage.task5: Promoting modern, energy-efficient, and export-oriented manufacturing;
tasksPage.task6: Creating permanent employment opportunities and boosting the region's industrial output.
funcGroup1Items: Drawing up land layout plans in accordance with the zone master plan;
Supervising utility grid installations and facility construction standards;
Area landscaping, waste management, and common property maintenance.
funcGroup2Items: Executing long-term lease agreements with electronic auction winners;
Systematic assessment of the fulfillment of contractual investment obligations;
Collaborating with government agencies to rapidly address operational challenges.
funcGroup3Items: Identifying utility and infrastructure requirements for industrial zones;
Coordinating infrastructure works with specialized utility service providers;
Ensuring network safety, reliability, and uninterrupted operation.
funcGroup4Items: Submitting periodic performance and capital investment reports to the regional Hokimiyat;
Maintaining statistics on newly created jobs and production volumes;
Publishing updates through public media channels to maintain administrative transparency.
